input.note: licence evidence recorded (licence field): MakeHuman core assets and the system-assets skin are CC0; MPFB is a GPL tool, not shipped

mesh_acceptance.note: two meshes (hand_l 11184, hand_r 10664 tris), each the MakeHuman hand and lower forearm (helpers and joint cubes removed by MPFB's own mask) joined with its closed-cuff sleeve, the left with its watch; slots hands_skin, hands_sleeve, hands_watch; lowest skin point 0.15 cm over the paper (fingertips rest on it)

scale.note: wrist joint to farthest fingertip 17.55 and 20.29 cm (adult hand about 17 to 20 cm; the MakeHuman default adult scaled 1.15, a large adult), forearm radius at the cuff 3.45 and 3.06 cm

finishing.note: skin albedo, normal and ORM at 2048 px baked from the displaced high poly (4676.8 px/m), sleeves with a closed rolled cuff and folds, smooth shading; evidence: the EEVEE check render beside the target (evidence/target-compare.jpg) and a close look (evidence/closeup.png); every file under 10 MB

lynx_commit_note: stamped by the writer: the newest commit touching this folder when the manifest was written
budget_note: fidelity sprint brief (2026-10-24): about 30k tris for the pair; visual only, for the target capture (no tracking)

generator.method: MakeHuman base mesh and default rig through the MPFB 2.0.18 Blender extension (scripts/art/hands/build_hands.bpy): fingers and wrists posed with the rig, armature and helper mask applied, the hand and lower forearm kept per side; a high-poly copy (subdivided 107392 faces per hand) displaced by script from the posed finger bones (joint and knuckle wrinkle lines, raised nail plates with their grooves, veins on the back of the hand: -0.45 to 0.846 mm) and baked onto the low mesh's own 2048 px atlas (albedo, normal, ORM); a scripted knit sleeve with a closed rolled cuff, ribbing and compression folds, running 42 cm up the arm so no end is in frame; a smartwatch on the left wrist; each side scaled 1.15, moved rigidly into the capture frame and dropped until its lowest fingertip rests on the paper
generator.skin_source_note: the MakeHuman albedo is sampled through its own UVs and re-baked (tinted by the detail fields) into textures/hands_skin_albedo.png on the new atlas

skin.file: skins/young_caucasian_male/young_lightskinned_male_diffuse.png (2048 px), the bake source of textures/hands_skin_albedo.png

licence: CC0. The MakeHuman base mesh, rig and targets: "All core assets (the base mesh, targets, skins...) are shared under CC0" (MPFB FAQ, https://static.makehumancommunity.org/mpfb/faq/can_i_sell_models.html, read 2026-10-24). The skin: the asset pack page lists it CC0 (https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/makehuman_system_assets.html) and its .mhmat says "This asset was explicitly released as CC0 in september 2020". The MPFB add-on code is GPL-3.0-or-later; it is a tool here, none of its code is shipped. The sleeve and the posing are our own.
materials: hands_skin: textures/hands_skin_albedo.png (sRGB), hands_skin_normal.png (tangent, OpenGL/glTF: UE flips green on import or set the texture's flip green) and hands_skin_orm.png (R 1, G roughness 0.439 / 0.563 / 0.644 at the 5th/50th/95th percentile: glossy nails, drier creases; B 0) on the new atlas (one UV set, 4676.8 px/m). UE: Preintegrated Skin or the Substrate wrap SSS (import_hands.py), roughness from ORM.G, specular 0.35

hands_sleeve: dark charcoal knit, #030304 linear about 0.013, roughness 0.92, sheen 0.4 (UE: Cloth shading model with fuzz colour #2A2D33, or Default Lit at roughness 0.95); folds, ribbing and the rolled cuff are geometry

hands_watch (left mesh only): near-black glossy, linear 0.010/0.011/0.013, roughness 0.22, metallic 0.3, clear coat 0.6: band, case and glass face in one slot (UE: a new M_HandsWatch, see import_hands.py)

bounds_cm.note: the pair together in the capture frame: X right, Y forward across the table, Z up (Blender); glTF is Y-up

placement.frame: capture frame: origin on the table plane at the centre of the near paper edge, X to the player's right, Y forward across the table, Z up; the meshes are already in it (no per-mesh transform needed beyond moving the frame onto the table)
placement.pose: the left hand rests with relaxed fingers on the near edge of the paper, palm down; the right hand points forward and down at a room with the index finger, the other fingers curled; both forearms leave the frame at the bottom corners under dark sleeves
placement.ue: import hands_capture.glb as two static meshes (hand_l, hand_r; 2 sections each, 4 draws), attach both to the capture pawn's table frame (not to the camera) at the near edge centre, yaw so +Y runs across the table; hide the SDK hands in the capture. Light them with the scene: they sit in the table's cool glow from below and the lamp agent's warm light from the far side

regenerate: blender -b --command extension install-file -r user_default -e <add-on-mpfb-v2.0.18.zip> (once); blender -b -P scripts/art/hands/build_hands.bpy -- <repo> <work> <young_lightskinned_male_diffuse.png>; blender -b -P scripts/art/hands/render_hands.bpy -- <repo> <work>; node scripts/art/hands/write_manifest.mjs <work>  (no --factory-startup: MPFB must load)
